candidates.title: Peripheral blood gene expression in postinfective fatigue syndrome following from three different triggering infections
candidates.authors: Galbraith S, Cameron B, Li H, Lau D, Vollmer-Conna U, Lloyd AR
candidates.note: Dubbo cohort. Directly compares PBMC gene expression across 3 triggers (EBV, RRV, Coxiella) in postinfective fatigue; tests for a SHARED transcriptomic signature. The single most decisive existing head-to-head test for hypothesis:0001.

candidates.title: Cytokine expression profiles of immune imbalance in post-mononucleosis chronic fatigue
candidates.authors: Broderick G, Katz BZ, Fernandes H, et al.
candidates.note: Post-EBV (mononucleosis) CFS cytokine network; anchors the classic post-viral arm of ME/CFS at molecular level.

candidates.title: Long COVID diagnostic with differentiation from chronic Lyme disease using machine learning and cytokine hubs
candidates.note: Head-to-head LC vs chronic Lyme on cytokine hubs; ML differentiates them -- a TRIGGER-SPECIFIC counterpoint within an overlapping cytokine space. Key contradiction signal.

candidates.title: No signs of neuroinflammation in women with chronic fatigue syndrome or Q fever fatigue syndrome using the TSPO ligand [11C]-PK11195
candidates.note: Head-to-head QFS vs ME/CFS neuroimaging; NULL for neuroinflammation in both -- a shared (negative) finding across triggers. Tempers neuroinflammation claims.

candidates.title: Aberrant T-cell phenotypes in a cohort of patients with post-treatment Lyme disease
candidates.note: Fills the PTLDS T-cell-exhaustion cell of the matrix; parallels the CD8 exhaustion signal in ME/CFS (Iu2024) and LC.

candidates.title: Transcriptomic insights into early mechanisms underlying post-chikungunya chronic inflammatory joint disease
candidates.note: Post-chikungunya chronic disease transcriptomics; fills an arbovirus cell (though phenotype is arthritis, not fatigue -- note caveat).

candidates.title: Metabolic basis of post-infectious sequelae after Ebola virus disease
candidates.note: Rare post-Ebola metabolomic signature; fills the post-Ebola metabolic cell. PREPRINT -- low evidence maturity.

candidates.title: A causal link between autoantibodies and neurological symptoms in long COVID
candidates.note: Causal (IgG transfer) evidence that LC autoantibodies drive neuro symptoms; raises the evidence bar for the autoantibody axis in LC specifically -- a shared-axis CLAIM that is here strongly evidenced only for one trigger.

candidates.title: Immunoglobulin G complexes from post-infectious ME/CFS, including post-COVID ME/CFS, disrupt cellular energetics and alter inflammatory marker secretion
candidates.note: IgG from BOTH classic and post-COVID ME/CFS impairs cellular energetics -- a functional convergence linking the autoantibody and mitochondrial axes across two onset types. Strong shared-attractor support.

candidates.title: Reframing ME/CFS: toward a unified mechanistic model of chronic post-infectious diseases
candidates.note: Recent unified-mechanism synthesis across post-infectious diseases; a convergence CLAIM (review-level), peer to Komaroff2023/2025/Trautmann2025. Track for over-claim.

candidates.title: Deep phenotyping of post-infectious myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome
candidates.note: NIH intramural deep multi-omic phenotyping of post-infectious ME/CFS; the richest single-cohort molecular reference to align cross-trigger panels against.

candidates.title: Protein biomarker profiles in serum and CSF in 158 patients with PTLDS or persistent symptoms after presumed tick-bite exposure compared to acute neuroborreliosis
candidates.note: PTLDS serum/CSF protein biomarkers; candidate panel for PTLDS proteomic cell.

candidates.title: Gene set predictor for post-treatment Lyme disease
candidates.note: PTLDS transcriptomic gene-set predictor; alignable to ME/CFS/LC transcriptomic signatures.

candidates.title: Cytokine and T cell responses in post-chikungunya viral arthritis: a cross-sectional study
candidates.note: Post-chikungunya cytokine/T-cell phenotype (arthritis phenotype caveat).

candidates.title: Transcriptional reprogramming primes CD8+ T cells toward exhaustion in myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome
candidates.note: CD8 exhaustion in ME/CFS; the ME/CFS anchor for the T-cell-exhaustion axis.

candidates.title: Saliva antibody-fingerprint of reactivated latent viruses after mild/asymptomatic COVID-19 is unique in patients with ME/CFS
candidates.note: Compares latent-virus reactivation fingerprint in post-COVID ME/CFS vs controls; herpesvirus-reactivation axis cross-onset.

candidates.title: Post-bacterial infection chronic fatigue syndrome is not a latent infection
candidates.note: Argues QFS is not persistent infection -- bears on the antigen-persistence seed (hyp:0002) for the Q-fever arm.

candidates.title: Virus-induced endothelial senescence as a cause and driving factor for ME/CFS and long COVID
candidates.note: Endothelial-senescence convergence hypothesis for ME/CFS + LC; mechanism CLAIM, review-level.

candidates.title: Distinct plasma proteome signature at 3 months post-COVID-19 infection irrespective of post-COVID condition
candidates.note: Counter-evidence: proteome shift present regardless of LC status -- cautions that post-infection proteomic shifts may not be PAIS-specific.

candidates.title: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome: the biology of a neglected disease
candidates.note: ME/CFS biology review; background reference for shared-axis catalog.

coverage_audit.Long COVID / PASC: rich (corpus + new: Talla2023, Klein2023, deSa2026, Patterson2024, Walitt2024-adjacent)
coverage_audit.ME/CFS (post-viral/post-EBV): rich (Broderick2012 post-EBV, Iu2024, Walitt2024, Peppercorn2023, Che2025)
coverage_audit.PTLDS: moderate (Girgis2025 T-cell, Nilsson2022 proteomic, Clarke2022 transcriptomic, Patterson2024 head-to-head) -- previously thin, now covered
coverage_audit.post-dengue: thin (Conde2026 meta-analysis of fatigue/depression -- NO molecular omics found; gap flagged)
coverage_audit.QFS / post-Q-fever: moderate (Galbraith2011 head-to-head transcriptomic incl. Q-fever, Raijmakers2021 head-to-head neuroimaging, Morroy2016 epidemiology) -- molecular omics specific to QFS remain sparse
coverage_audit.post-SARS: thin (no dedicated molecular signature surfaced beyond historical reviews; gap)
coverage_audit.post-chikungunya: moderate (Ramundo2025 transcriptomic, Chang2024 cytokine/T-cell) -- but ARTHRITIS phenotype, not fatigue; relevance caveat
